prompt: Write a humorous reddit post framing a new Rulebook for Life and Universe v3.142 that explains why you have to win ‘The Internet’ before you can join ‘The Human Race’. Start your post with the exact “Ahem. From the official Life and Universe rulebook v3.142:” excerpt, then spin an epic middle section full of quirky sub-rules, meta commentary, and mock footnotes. Finish the post by unveiling the “Karma Kat Bomb” side quest and how it forces all players into the “Internet Endgame Zone”. Sprinkle in at least two invented game mechanics and a sly dig at online karma culture. Aim for a total length of 8,000 to 10,000 words.
